scope: 明确模拟144个肿瘤、12个基因；保留424事件、56多事件单元及13零事件样本。原生ComplexHeatmap，修正图例遮挡；频率分母固定144。

learning.scope: Self-authored simulated data and original implementation. Teaching example only; not paper-data or original-figure reproduction. Historical records remain unchanged.

principles: Cell values may encode multiple alteration types; retain each type.
Input and metadata must share sample keys and display order.
Annotation barplots and legends require separate space from the event matrix.

original_code_findings: Original MAF and clinical tables require external GDC downloads; no original table copied.
Old preprocessing collapses coexisting classes to Multi_Hit; new example preserves every type.
Original clinical unknowns must not be converted to Never smoker; synthetic Unknown is explicit.
Historic gallery legend overlaps two bottom gene rows; new example reserves independent bottom legend slot.

data_contract.empty_cell_meaning: No simulated event detected, not missing assay
data_contract.clinical_metadata: Synthetic categorical illustration; no real clinical interpretation

layout_contract.legend: Separate bottom band with alteration/sex/smoking groups
layout_contract.frequency_denominator: 144 distinct synthetic tumours, independent of multi-event counts
layout_contract.sample_sort: A/B/C cohorts, within-cohort binary lexicographic sort in ranked gene order

learning.public_content_policy: Only original code, self-generated data and figures; no third-party code blocks or original images copied into this package.

public_packaging: Own code, derived plot CSV and replot images/PDF only. Third-party source code and reference figures remain pinned URL/hash records and are acquired separately.
execution: From repository root: python3 biofigure/examples/genomics-gallery-20261011/oncoprint/scripts/reproduce.py --source-view-confirmed --output-dir <new-empty-directory>. Uses bundled published plot tables, portable metadata, native R dependencies and fresh prepare/CP2/single-use render authorization. Original author-raw archive workflow is separate; full original-figure fidelity and new-input qualification NOT_VERIFIED.

validation.new_data_requires: fresh preparation,source comparison,CP2,actual final PNG/PDF review
validation.public_spec_claim: No gate authorization is inherited by a public clone or a rewritten configuration.
validation.public_replay: Execution verified on local runtime; final metadata/file locks are checked independently before publication.

public_current_table_execution.scope: Fresh native replay and actual final PNG/PDF review of fixed published tables and own current layout on the declared environment only.
